source: CAN/CIOSC 104:2021, Baseline cyber security controls for small and medium organizations (Digital Governance Standards Institute), as used in the OCI Digital Competence Centre Cybersecurity Workbook

sections.name: Leadership commitment
sections.note: About management setting security policy and objectives. None of our questions test this.

sections.name: Accountability for IT security
sections.note: About naming a senior person accountable for IT security. None of our questions test this.

sections.name: Cyber security risk assessment
sections.note: This check-up and its risk register are a starting point, but the questions do not test this section.

sections.name: Point of sale and financial systems
sections.note: Applies to businesses that take card payments. None of our questions test this.

sections.name: Security log management
sections.note: No CCCS control covers log management, so this section is assessed directly by the sign-in alerts question. It checks that someone reviews your email provider's alerts, not full log collection.
